cells.title: Stop the Pi result-inbox drain at session shutdown and name the live pi package in doctor
cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1, D2 and the header half of D3. (a) In .pi/extensions/bee-guard/events.ts, the session_shutdown handler: right after the existing stopBrokerTimer() call (which already sits after the reload early return), call stopDrainTimer() imported from ./result-inbox.ts. Do not touch the reload path. (b) In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/doctor.rs runtime_checks_with_env, change the pi install hint to npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent; update any test that pins the old string (rg mariozechner). (c) In .pi/extensions/bee-guard/index.ts, the existing CEILING header block: change it to Pi 1.6.0 proven live on 2026-11-24 in this repo (pi -p ok probe printed ok with empty stderr on openai-codex gpt-6-luna and zai glm-5.3-flash; a pre-gate write was refused by the worktree-first guard). Keep the block's shape and the probe sentence. The build embeds .pi/extensions/bee-guard into the binary, so rebuild before testing. Add no new code comments beyond rewording that existing header block. After the edits run bee dev regen (render-skill-trees, onboard --repo-root . --apply, release-manifest --write) inside this cell, restore any re-rendered .claude/skills tree it changed, and commit docs/history/codex-harness-hardening/release-manifest.json with the change.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test pi_plugin_contracts && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

must_haves.why: A drain timer outliving its Pi session prints stale-ctx advisories on every tick, and doctor sends users to a pi below the belt floor.
truths: after session_shutdown with a non-reload reason no drain interval remains armed
after session_shutdown with reason reload the drain interval stays armed
prohibitions: No change to the reload early return

cells.title: Test that Pi session shutdown disarms the drain and doctor names the live package
cells.action: Without reading the p16u-1 worker's notes, check the p16u-1 commit against CONTEXT.md D1 and D2 and add behavior tests. In tests/pi_plugin_contracts.rs, reuse the node harness of session_shutdown_closes_record_on_real_end_reasons_and_skips_reload: start a session with a bee store and a usable session id so startResultDrain arms its interval, then fire session_shutdown with reason quit and assert no drain interval remains armed (the belt keeps it in state.drainTimer and the globalThis drain slot), and fire it with reason reload and assert the interval stays armed. Watch the quit test fail against the pre-fix events.ts before trusting it. In src/doctor/tests.rs add a test that the pi runtime check's install hint names @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent and not @mariozechner. Fix any defect in p16u-1's code and name it in the cap. No code comments.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test pi_plugin_contracts && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee doctor

a test fails if reload disarms the drain

cells.title: Record the Pi 1.4.0 to 1.6.0 capability audit
cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D3 on the audit page. Update the title, description and the Data Dictionary 'Last live-evidence version' row to 1.6.0 (2026-11-24, ok probe on openai-codex gpt-6-luna and zai glm-5.3-flash, guarded write refused, pi_plugin_contracts green). Add a section 'The 1.4.0 to 1.6.0 audit' after the 1.0.0 to 1.4.0 one, same table shape, covering four releases 1.5.0 (2026-11-02), 1.5.1 (2026-11-09), 1.5.2 (2026-11-10), 1.6.0 (2026-11-20), with rows: 1.5.0 BREAKING pi-schema tool argument validation (keep: belt tool parameters are plain JSON Schema, tool-verdict.ts VERDICT_TOOL_PARAMETERS and tool-steer.ts BEE_STEER_TOOL_PARAMETERS); 1.5.1 BREAKING GrepOperations.readFile and OpenAI empty tools omitted (keep, no belt surface); 1.6.0 BREAKING component render() returns readonly string[] (keep: workers-widget.ts returns its own rows array and subclasses no Container); 1.5.0 blocked option for ctx.ui.custom, Usage.cost.totalFromProvider, pi.exec maxBuffer (keep, out of scope per CONTEXT.md); 1.6.0 fix that RPC switch/fork no longer runs session_start twice (keep, belt-relevant fix); the fifteen events (keep, all in the 1.6.0 binary by rg -a -c); built-in registry (keep, 1.6.0 docs/settings.md:46 same eight names); stale ctx after session_shutdown (adapt, p16u-1: the drain now stops at shutdown). Read the CHANGELOG under /home/thanhsmind/.local/share/mise/installs/pi/1.6.0/pi/ for line numbers. Cite CONTEXT.md D-numbers, never raw decision ids. Add the 1.6.0 tree to the Pointers 'Upstream compared' line. Do not use the words deferred, until or later. Write through bee-technical-writing.

must_haves.why: The audit page is the authority for which Pi versions the belt was checked against.
truths: the page names 1.6.0 as the last live-evidence version
every 1.5.0, 1.5.1 and 1.6.0 breaking entry has a row
prohibitions: No raw decision ids from this feature
